rationale: The evidence supports translation_implies_source=yes and source_implies_translation=no: the translated general iid theorem specializes to the Bernoulli result, while the Bernoulli result does not recover the general theorem. Under the installed schema, that pair mechanically classifies the judgment as faithful-stronger and requires accepted=true. This schema-level acceptance does not erase the substantive concern: the Bernoulli/two-point-support premise and de Moivre-Laplace identity were omitted, so adjudication remains requested.
